Custom lowercase humanist grotesk sokan with distinctive angled k. Mature dry wit, visibly handmade carved wood, NOT Groot or existing character. Expressions: attentive, carrying a small blank tray, satisfied. Sparse bonsai roots and old ivory deadwood accent. Deep forest / clay / flax.

name: Bruma
design: Quiet cinematic woodland identity. Dawn redwood featherlike paired needles, living lineage and seasonal copper. LOGO: an abstract compact stepped open B built from paired staggered horizontal branch cuts along a curved vertical trunk, just five thick segments with negative space, reproducible in black. Wordmark bruma wide and precise lowercase with subtle flared r. MASCOT: tall slim rust-brown redwood trunk scout with an elongated almond silhouette, three discrete tiers of paired sage feather branches as a cloak, eyes as two short dark cuts near upper trunk, little root boots; calm observant posture and understated humour. Flat 2D ink-cut illustration, sage and oxidized copper, tactile paper edge, no fluffy blob. Three poses: peering through mist, pointing the route, resting. Background subtle foggy stone bands.

name: Kobai
design: Confident contemporary Japanese apricot, no oriental pastiche. Winter blossoms emerge from rugged branches. LOGO: a single heavy bent branch stroke joined to a compact off-centre round bud; their negative space forms a bespoke lowercase k. Not a five-petal generic beauty salon flower. Wordmark kobai sculpted geometric lowercase with excellent optical kerning. MASCOT: small round but angular terracotta woody apricot bud-bodied companion, two distinctive projecting old-wood branch arms, one dusty-rose FIVE-petal flower placed off-centre on its head, two expressive etched eyebrows and tiny eyes, little broad dark feet. Sophisticated cel-animation character with earthy solid colours, not kawaii sticker, no giant eyes. Three poses: sleeves-up determination, curious sideways lean, opening blossom celebration. Muted plum charcoal, clay rose and dry olive.

name: Wolle

LOGO: two nested angular paired leaf bands folded into a wide compact W, 4 broad simple planes, no ornament, flat dark olive. Wordmark wolle sturdy friendly custom lowercase with linked-but-distinct double l. Stop-motion cork and carved olivewood texture, distinct from a human, not Groot. Three poses: guarding a small seed, purposeful walk, welcoming. Moss, cork, warm sand. Contemporary adventurous confidence.

name: Véu

name: Fronda

name: Lampe
